units.source_text: 千重子像是遭到了突然袭击，又看了看腰带，

en.t: Chieko looked as if she had been caught off guard, and glanced again at the obi,

units.source_text: “所谓协调，还得看穿什么和服和什么人穿呢。

en.t: When people speak of harmony, it depends on what kimono is being worn and who is wearing it.

units.source_text: 不过……如今还时兴有意穿破坏协调的衣裳哪。”

en.t: Still... these days it is even fashionable to deliberately wear clothes that disrupt harmony.
